text:
Camila: hi everyone, first day — i'm stuck. Okta SSO fails with "SSL error: certificate not trusted" when i try to authenticate, and the 1Password invite went to my old gmail. any pointers?

Ben (IT): welcome Camila :wave: quick q: are you on the office network or at home? which OS/browser?

Camila: at a coworking spot today (their wifi). macOS Monterey, using Chrome. Okta page shows a red lock and a big SSL warning before the login form.

it-onboard-bot: ONB-9016 created for okta-ssl-trust-issue:2795000000. Assigned to Ben (IT). ETA 2h.

Ben (IT): hmm coworking networks sometimes do TLS interception. It could also be our internal CA not in your trust store because your laptop was imaged differently. Two quick checks: 1) try the same flow on your phone (cellular) to rule out network MITM, 2) paste the full cert chain text from the browser devtools (Security tab) or a screenshot.

Camila: phone on cellular works and Okta page loads cleanly there. screenshot attached from Chrome showing the issuer is "RedwoodCorp Internal CA" and the browser says it's untrusted.

Ben (IT): that confirms it: your laptop doesn't trust our internal root. Did you use the company image or bring-your-own device?

Camila: BYOD. shipped a company laptop but it's still in transit. i installed the corporate wifi profile earlier but not the root cert because the install doc looked CLI-heavy.

Ben (IT): okay — i can push a managed root cert via Jamf if you want us to enroll the device, but for BYOD we can also have you manually install the root so you can finish onboarding now. i'll paste a one-click URL for the root and the install steps.

Camila: i'd prefer manual for now. paste away.

Ben (IT): installing the cert: 1) download from https://intranet.redwood.dev/roots/redwood-root.pem 2) open in Keychain Access -> System -> add and set trust to Always Trust 3) restart Chrome. After that Okta should load normally. If you prefer i can ship a script.

Camila: installed the cert and restarted Chrome. Okta loads now but when i try to enroll MFA it says my account is pending provisioning. also 1Password invite still only in my old gmail per Heather's invite email.

it-onboard-bot: ONB-9016 updated: cert install confirmed by user. Noted provisioning delay.

Ben (IT): provisioning lag sometimes happens between People Ops account creation and our directory sync. Heather, can you confirm Camila's canonical email and re-trigger provisioning?

Heather (People Ops): confirmed canonical is camila@redwood.dev. i see an old invite to camila.personal@gmail.com in the HR system — my bad. re-provisioning now and resending 1Password to the correct account.

1Password-bot: 1Password invite resent to camila@redwood.dev (item: Redwood - New Hire Seat).

Camila: got the 1Password invite, accepted and set a password. MFA still shows "pending provisioning" in Okta when i try to enroll a security key.

Ravi (Security): pending provisioning means the device cert and account mapping haven't synced to Okta yet. Ben, can you trigger a manual sync for the user? I'll also temporarily allow TOTP for Camila so she can finish access while we wait.

Ben (IT): triggering directory sync and clearing Okta pending flags for camila@redwood.dev now. Also enabling TOTP fallback for 24h as Ravi suggested.

Camila: tried again and Okta accepted MFA setup. I set up Okta Verify (TOTP) and then registered a passkey. Everything looks good now. I can see eng-team drive and the engineer onboarding vault in 1Password.

Noelle (Eng): welcome Camila! I'll grant repo access once you confirm your GitHub SSO connected (should show up in the console). Ping me and i'll add you to the eng team channel.

Ben (IT): ONB-9016 resolved: root cert manual install + directory reprovision + temporary TOTP fallback. Action: Heather to audit invite process to avoid misrouting. Ravi to confirm internal CA trust onboarding doc updated.

Heather (People Ops): will update the invite workflow and added a check for previous personal emails before sending invites. sorry for the confusion and welcome again!

Camila: thanks all, appreciate the quick help. excited to get started :rocket:
